newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian import prices rise 1.8 pct in June.
newsitem.headline: Australian import prices rise 1.8 pct in June.

text.p: Australian import prices rose 1.8 percent in June from the previous month and were 0.4 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
"A continuing fall in the value of the Australian dollar against the major trading currencies in June resulted in price increases for a wide range of items," the bureau said.
"This is the largest increase recorded in the index since May 1995."
The index stood at 109.2 in June, the highest level since 109.3 in February.
The monthly increase was the largest in more than 15 months, while the annual decline was the lowest in 15 months.
